channel.title: Signal to Decision
channel.description: A monthly briefing for business leaders on how AI changes the decisions they own. By M Usman.

item.title: Applied AI for business leaders: the tool, the skill and the number that proves it (October 2026)
item.description: October's AI tools target stated pain points. In my reading, the skill your team builds and one fixed number decide the return.

item.title: Applied AI for business leaders: four checks before you trust an AI vendor (September 2026)
item.description: Google and OpenAI each had AI go beyond its limits. Four checks tell you where your own vendor stands.

item.title: Signal to Decision — August 2026: Who owns your company's AI? In August, the answer changed
item.description: August 2026 reviewed: every layer of the AI stack changed hands. Model access, weights, inference silicon, the data context, and the authority to check any of it.

item.title: Signal to Decision — July 2026
item.description: Permission, price and provenance become architecture decisions. A frontier model goes dark and returns, open weights reach the frontier, and the stack gets priced chair by chair.

item.title: Signal to Decision — June 2026
item.description: The first standard monthly edition. Make, buy, or boost: the cost of agents, eighteen days of export control, the open-weight surge, and the month read chair by chair.

item.title: Signal to Decision — 2026 so far
item.description: The launch year-to-date consolidation, January to 6 June 2026.
